summary: Beacon Plaza is a 12-suite, 66,360 SF Charlotte, NC office asset. The 2026-08-31 certified rent roll controls: 9 suites (49,770 SF) in active possession, 1 pending (Suite 010, no possession), 2 vacant, so unit and area occupancy are both 0.7500 versus the manager's 10-of-12 (0.8333) headline. Annual in-place rent on active suites is $1,214,100. Per underwriting instructions, gross potential rent is all-suite scheduled monthly rent ($133,500) x 12 = $1,618,800; less 5% economic loss plus $350/suite other income gives EGI of $1,542,060. Expenses of $499,526 (tax $169,974, insurance $56,658, other $226,632, 3% management $46,262) yield NOI before reserves of $1,042,534; after $300/suite reserves ($3,600), NCF is $1,038,934. Capitalized at 7.5000%, value is $13,900,456. Sizing at the greater of note rate 6.7500% and 6.00% floor (so 6.7500%, floor not binding), 30-year monthly amortization: LTV limit $8,340,274, DSCR limit $10,678,767, debt-yield limit $11,543,713; maximum loan $8,340,274 (LTV binding). Sources/uses: less $6,500,000 payoff, $83,403 origination fee and $45,000 closing costs, net cash-out is $1,711,871 (no shortfall). Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (live formulas, sensitivity table, source register) and artifacts/memorandum-v1.pdf (5-page OM). Asking price, photos, market comps and sponsor history are not supplied and were not invented.
qualifications: Underwritten EGI applies the prescribed 5% economic loss to all 12 suites' scheduled rent while 25% of area is not in active possession; underwritten NOI is a stabilized figure above T12 actuals and depends on possession by Suite 010 and lease-up of Suites 011 and 012 at roll rents.
The 2026-06-30 archive roll (lower rents, e.g. Suite 001 at $10,975) is stale and superseded by the 2026-08-31 certified roll and the executed lease; the conflict is resolved, not unresolved.
T12 statement does not report a management fee, replacement reserves or NCF; those historical amounts are unknown, not zero.
Capitalized value is an income-approach indication at the prescribed 7.5000% rate only; no market sales or rent comparables, asking price, photos or sponsor history are in the packet.
Sizing uses a 30-year amortizing payment at the greater rate as instructed even though the first 24 months are interest-only; interest-only period mechanics beyond that statement are unknown.
Insurance evidence is a general liability declaration only ($2,000,000 aggregate, 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30); property/casualty/BI coverage terms and lender requirements are not supplied.
Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews are incomplete per diligence-status.pdf; no defect, contamination, litigation or structural finding is asserted.
